elevation.$description: Elevation expresses z-order. Each level is a hairline ring plus very soft shadows; there is no surface tint. The first layer of every level above 0 is the ring (spread 1, no blur): it sits OUTSIDE the container bounds, like a shadow spread, so it never changes the container size. Platforms without shadow spread draw it as a 1-unit outside border. Shadow values have the semantics of CSS box-shadow: `blur` is the CSS blur radius (the Gaussian's standard deviation is blur / 2), `spread` grows the shadow's shape before blurring. A platform whose shadow API takes another quantity converts: it never passes the number through.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product stacks surfaces at several heights: resting cards, raised controls, menus, dialogs.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: Six levels of lift, each a list of shadow layers whose colors are roles, so they follow the scheme. A layer with no offset, no blur and a positive spread is a ring: draw it as a border.
rules: Use a level as a whole. Do not build shadows from literals.
Level changes express state (hover lifts one level); do not use elevation for decoration.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: Shadows are replaced whole by a system; the rule language deliberately has no shadow math.

level0.$description: No elevation: an empty list of shadow layers, so nothing is drawn.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: A single soft shadow per level, no outline ring.
